Class FastStatsBukkit

java.lang.Object
dev.faststats.bukkit.FastStatsBukkit
public final class FastStatsBukkit extends Object
FastStats for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper and Folia plugins.

Create the context in your plugin, make it ready in onEnable and shut it down in onDisable: 

private final FastStatsContext context = FastStatsBukkit.builder(this)
        .metrics(Metrics.Factory::create)
        .service(ErrorTrackerService.create(ErrorTracker.contextAware()))
        .build();

@Override
public void onEnable() {
    context.ready();
}

@Override
public void onDisable() {
    context.shutdown();
}
Since:
0.33.0

  • Method Details

    • builder

      @Contract(value="_ -> new", mutates="io") public static FastStatsContext.Builder builder(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin plugin)
      Creates a new context builder for the given plugin.

      The shared FastStats config is read from plugins/faststats/config.properties right away. If no token is set, the token injected at build time is read from META-INF/faststats/<plugin name>.token. If no token was injected, a warning is logged and the built context is disabled.

      The built context must be made ready in or after onEnable, as Bukkit rejects tasks and listeners of plugins that are not enabled yet.

      Parameters:
      plugin - the plugin
      Returns:
      a new context builder
      Since:
      0.33.0
